name: narrow_qrs_duration_ranges
mechanism: The QRS complex is narrowed to physiological 80-100 ms by reducing the Gaussian center offsets and widths for Q, R, and S waves.
code_snippet: Tightened QRS Gaussian sigma/offsets: sigma_q 0.004-0.006, sigma_r 0.006-0.010, sigma_s 0.004-0.006, q_offset 0.010-0.016, s_offset 0.020-0.030.

name: asymmetric_t_wave_modeling
mechanism: Each subject's T-wave is synthesized with distinct left/right Gaussian widths and anchored by its 3-sigma right tail to the QT offset, increasing physiological T-wave morphology diversity without altering QRS width.

name: subject_specific_p_qrs_variability
mechanism: Adds per-subject physiological variation to PR interval, P-wave amplitude/width, and QRS width while constraining QRS duration to 80-100 ms, reducing mode collapse after amplitude normalization.
code_snippet: pr_interval = np.random.uniform(0.12, 0.20); sigma_p = np.random.uniform(0.015, 0.028); p_amp_II = np.random.uniform(0.10, 0.20); q_center = -np.random.uniform(0.012, 0.020); s_center = np.random.unif

name: asymmetric_qrs_waveform_diversity
mechanism: Replacing symmetric QRS Gaussian kernels with subject-specific asymmetric Q/R/S Gaussian kernels and broader amplitude-ratio ranges makes dominant QRS morphology more varied across subjects, reducing embedding similarity.
code_snippet: gaussian_wave_asym(t, center, sigma_left, sigma_right, amplitude) for Q/R/S waves
